charts.title: Most popular social networks worldwide as of April 2024, ranked by number of monthly active users (in millions)
charts.short: Global social networks ranked by number of users 2024
charts.description: Market leader Facebook was the first social network to surpass one billion registered accounts and currently sits at more than three billion monthly active users. Meta Platforms owns four of the biggest social media platforms, all with more than one billion monthly active users each: Facebook (core platform), WhatsApp, Facebook Messenger, and Instagram. In the third quarter of 2023, Facebook reported around four billion monthly core Family product users.

charts.title: Leading mobile apps worldwide in March 2024, by downloads (in millions)
charts.short: Most downloaded mobile apps worldwide 2024
charts.description: In March 2024, Meta-powered apps Facebook and Instagram were the most downloaded mobile apps worldwide, with 59 million and 58 million downloads, respectively. Social video app TikTok followed with 46 million downloads. Meta-owned microblogging platform Threads generated 24 million downloads during the last month of the year.
charts.note: Worldwide; March 2024; iOS Apple App Store and Google Play Store
charts.source: Appfigures Number of downloads in millions

charts.title: Share of time spent among TikTok users in the United States engaging with social media apps as of February 2023
charts.short: U.S. TikTok users share of time spent on social media apps 2023
charts.description: As of February 2023, TikTok users in the United States spent 32 percent of the time they dedicated to social media engagement with the popular short-video platform. Meta-owned Facebook and Instagram commanded 20 percent of the online social time of TikTok users in the U.S., respectively. In comparison, the YouTube mobile app kept users engaged for 15 percent of all the time they chose to dedicate to social media.

charts.title: Number of TikTok downloads from 1st quarter 2018 to 4th quarter 2023 (in millions)
charts.short: TikTok global quarterly downloads 2018-2023
charts.description: In the fourth quarter of 2023, TikTok generated around 232 million downloads from users worldwide. Initially launched in China first by ByteDance as Douyin, the short-video format was popularized by TikTok and took over the global social media environment in 2020. In the first quarter of 2020, TikTok downloads peaked at over 313.5 million worldwide, up by 62.3 percent compared to the first quarter of 2019.
charts.note: Worldwide; Q1 2018 to Q4 2023; iOS and Android combined

charts.title: Markets with the highest growth of TikTok downloads from the Apple App Store in 4th quarter 2024
charts.short: Growth of TikTok iOS downloads worldwide Q4 2023, by market
charts.description: In the last quarter of 2024, TikTok downloads via the Apple App Store only experienced an increase of almost 40 percent in China. The popular social video experienced a 33 percent growth in iOS downloads in the Japanese market, while South Korea saw the app downloads among iOS users grow by 24 percent. At the end of 2023, countries in the Asia-Pacific region drew the quarterly download growth of TikTok on the Apple App Store.
charts.source: AppMagic; Statista Growth compared to previous quarter

charts.title: Countries with the highest growth of TikTok downloads from the Google Play Store in 4th quarter 2023
charts.short: Growth of TikTok Google Play downloads worldwide Q4 2023, by country
charts.description: According to recent industry measurements, TikTok downloads among Canadian Android users experienced a 156 percent increase compared to the previous quarter. The Dominican republic was the second fastest-growing market for the social video app sensation, with 89 percent quarter-over-quarter increase in downloads via the Google Play Store. The United States, which is one of TikTok's main markets, ranked third with 60 percent download increase in the last registered quarter.
charts.note: Worldwide; Q4 2023; QoQ growth, Android only
charts.source: AppMagic; Statista Growth compared to previous quarter

charts.title: TikTok in-app purchase revenues worldwide from 1st quarter of 2018 to 4th quarter 2023 (in million U.S. dollars)
charts.short: TikTok mobile app global IAP revenues 2018-2023
charts.description: In the fourth quarter of 2023, TikTok generated approximately 707 million U.S. dollars in revenues from users worldwide. Between the end of 2021 and the beginning of 2022, TikTok's in-app revenues experienced staggering growth, going from 286 million U.S. dollars in the third quarter of 2020 to over 606 million U.S. dollars in the fourth quarter of 2021.
charts.note: Worldwide; Q1 2018 to Q4 2023; Google Play and Apple App Store combined; IAP revenues reduced by platform fees and taxes

charts.title: TikTok annual consumer spending worldwide from 2016 to 2023 (in million U.S. dollars)
charts.short: Global TikTok annual consumer spending 2016-2023
charts.description: In 2023, TikTok generated 3.8 billion U.S. dollars in consumer spending. This number adds to a previous total of more than six billion U.S. dollars, collected cumulatively since 2016. Overall, 2021 was the first time TikTok generated more than one billion U.S. dollars of consumer spending in a single year, and that number has continued to grow, almost doubling in 2022 and nearly reaching four billion in 2023.
charts.note: Worldwide; 2016 to 2023; across iOS, Google Play; China is iOS only; inclusive of any percent taken by the app stores

charts.title: Leading markets based on TikTok iOS revenue in 4th quarter 2023 (in million U.S. dollars)
charts.short: TikTok iOS revenue in leading markets Q4 2023
charts.description: TikTok generated more than 303 million U.S. dollars in China from iOS in the last quarter of 2023. The United States followed, with a revenue of 65 million U.S. dollars during the last measure quarter, while Japan ranked third as the country generated over almost 29 million U.S. dollars in revenues via the Apple App Store.
charts.source: AppMagic Revenue in million U.S. dollars

charts.title: Leading markets based on TikTok Google Play revenue in 4th quarter 2023 (in million U.S. dollars)
charts.short: TikTok Google Play revenue in leading markets Q4 2023
charts.description: In the fourth quarter of 2023, the video-sharing app TikTok generated more than 50 million U.S. dollars in app revenues in the United States via Google Play, with the country accounting for 26 percent of TikTok's revenues throughout the Google Play Store. Germany followed with approximately 20 million U.S. dollars in revenues, while Japan came in third with 18.25 million U.S. dollars generated don TikTok via the Google Play Store.
charts.source: AppMagic Revenue in million U.S. dollars

charts.title: Number of TikTok users worldwide from 2018 to 2027 (in millions)
charts.short: Global TikTok users 2018-2027
charts.description: In 2022, TikTok counted approximately 1.7 billion users worldwide, up by over 66 percent compared to 2020. Launched in 2017 as the international version of Chinese-developed social media Douyin, TikTok rose to popularity in 2020, reaching a peak of approximately 313.5 million downloads during the first quarter of the year. The popular social media platform is forecasted to reach approximately 2.25 billion users in 2027.

charts.title: TikTok penetration in selected countries and territories as of January 2024
charts.short: TikTok penetration in selected countries and territories 2024
charts.description: As of January 2024, the United Arab Emirates and Saudi Arabia were the countries with the highest TikTok reach, with virtually over 130 percent of the population aged 18 and older using the popular social video app. Malaysia followed, with a reach of 113 percent. charts.short: TikTok: video views 2023, by length
charts.description: From March 2023 to August 2023, TikTok videos with a duration of over 54 seconds saw on average of 38 thousand views. Shorter videos generated progressively fewer views. Videos with a length of fewer than 10 seconds saw the smallest amounts of views, with around 19 thousand views on average. Videos with a length of between 16 to 53 seconds presented around 30 thousand views on average.
